name: Burroot Kwama Mine
summary: The Burroot Kwama Mine is a kwama mine located just west of Elden Root in Grahtwood, containing thunderbugs. The thunderbugs infesting the mine have killed many of the kwama within. They are led by a massive thunderbug named Stormhead the Ravenous. Some notes can be found here. Scribs are found inside and just outside.
